key_idea: When the beam is balanced, both sides add up to the same number.
steps: The left side has 9. The right side has 3, ? and ?.
The two question tokens are the same and add up to 6: 3 + 3 = 6. Each one is 3.

review.note: Figure check: the two pans hang at different distances from the middle (the right pan is closer), so a real beam would not balance this way. The intended reading (both sides add up to the same) gives B. Consider hanging the pans at equal distances.
